title: Cancelled short-notice flight, crew shortage
narrative: My flight from Lisbon to Vienna was cancelled. They emailed me on the 3rd, the flight was on the 6th. I had to buy a train ticket in the end. I want to know what I am owed.

documents.content:
BOOKING QX7T4L — Passenger: A. MENDES (adult)
Carrier: Meridian Air (MR)
MR414  LIS 06 Mar 2026 07:40  ->  VIE 06 Mar 2026 11:55
Single booking reference. Great-circle distance LIS-VIE: 2,090 km.
Status: CONFIRMED. Fare paid: 214.00 units.

From: notifications@meridian-air.example
To: a.mendes@example.org
Sent: 03 Mar 2026 09:12 UTC
Subject: Cancellation of MR414 on 06 Mar 2026

We regret to inform you that MR414 (LIS-VIE, 06 Mar) has been cancelled. Your booking has been refunded in full. No alternative flight was offered on this routing.

MERIDIAN AIR OPS LOG — MR414 / 06MAR2026
Status: CANCELLED
Cause code: CRW-DUTY
Cause text: Operating crew unavailable; standby crew exceeded permitted duty hours. No reserve crew at LIS base.
No weather restriction in force at LIS or VIE.

derivation: S3.2(b) crew out of duty hours -> carrier-controlled
S4.2 notice 03 Mar 09:12 -> 06 Mar 07:40 is under 7 days -> 100%
S4.3/S4.4 no re-routing offered, no exemption
